translations.Elige una paleta para tu espacio. Podrás: Choose a palette for your space. You can change it any time from Profile.
translations.Túmbate boca arriba y eleva el tronco y: Lie on your back and lift your torso and legs together to bring your hands toward your feet. Lower with control and keep your lower back stable.
translations.Acerca manos y pies sin dar impulso: Bring your hands and feet together without swinging
translations.Regresa despacio y evita arquear la espa: Return slowly and avoid arching your back
translations.Siéntate erguido, junta las plantas de l: Sit upright, bring the soles of your feet together and gently move your knees up and down. Keep your back long and the movement comfortable; do not push your legs.
translations.Junta las plantas de los pies y acerca l: Bring the soles of your feet together and draw your heels in as far as comfortable
translations.Mantén la espalda larga mientras mueves: Keep your back long as you gently move your knees
translations.Respira con calma y evita presionar las: Breathe calmly and avoid pressing your knees toward the floor
translations.Empieza cuando quieras. Tu primer entren: Start whenever you’re ready. Your first workout counts from today.
translations.Puedes activar los avisos desde los ajus: You can turn on notifications in Android settings.
translations.Importar copia o crear perfil: Import a backup or start a new profile
translations.Corrige este registro sin perder el rest: Edit this entry without changing your other measurements.
translations.Ajusta la postura Controla el recorrido: Set your posture Control the range of motion Breathe through the effort
translations.Mapa de músculos principales y secundari: Map of primary and supporting muscles worked
translations.Prepara una postura estable, lleva la ba: Set a stable stance, bring the bar from the clean position and press it overhead with control.
translations.Mantén el tronco estable durante la tran: Keep your torso stable through the transition
translations.Mantén el brazo de trabajo estable contr: Keep your working arm steady against your thigh
translations.Mantén el tronco firme y controla la ele: Brace your torso and raise and lower your body as one unit, keeping your core engaged throughout.
translations.Mantén el abdomen activo durante todo el: Keep your core engaged throughout the movement
translations.Desde la suspensión, activa el abdomen y: From a hang, engage your core and lats to raise your body into a front lever with control.
translations.Mantén los brazos y el tronco firmes dur: Keep your arms and torso steady as you lift
translations.Usa una progresión adecuada a tu nivel: Choose a progression that matches your level
translations.Sujeta las mancuernas con agarre neutro: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip and curl with your elbows close to your sides. Lower the weight slowly.
translations.Mantén las palmas enfrentadas durante el: Keep your palms facing each other throughout the movement
translations.Colócate en posición invertida con apoyo: Get into an inverted position with stable support. Engage your core to balance without over-arching your back.
translations.Mantén el abdomen activo y las costillas: Keep your core engaged and your ribs tucked
translations.Practica junto a un apoyo seguro y sal d: Practice beside a stable support and exit the position with control
translations.Realiza el movimiento de snowboard con c: Shift your weight with control as you move, and keep a pace you can sustain.
translations.Realiza siete repeticiones en la mitad i: Do seven reps in the lower half of the range, seven in the upper half, then seven full reps. Stay in control throughout.
translations.Completa las tres fases sin impulso: Complete all three phases without using momentum
translations.Evita arquear la zona lumbar al presiona: Avoid arching your lower back as you press the bar
translations.Controla la barra tanto al subir como al: Control the bar on both the lift and the descent
translations.Apoya el brazo contra la cara interna de: Brace your arm against your inner thigh and curl the dumbbell without rocking your torso.
translations.Evita usar impulso para levantar la manc: Avoid using momentum to lift the dumbbell
translations.Baja lentamente hasta extender el codo c: Lower slowly until your elbow is extended
translations.Reduce el recorrido si pierdes el contro: Shorten the range of motion if you lose control
translations.Distribuye el peso de forma estable entr: Distribute your weight evenly between your hands
translations.Eleva las rodillas de forma alterna a un: Raise your knees in an alternating, steady rhythm. Keep your torso upright and adjust the intensity to your level.
translations.Reduce el ritmo si pierdes el equilibrio: Slow down if you lose your balance or control
